name: Present Simple
description: Habits, routines, facts and repeated actions.

name: Present Continuous
description: Actions happening now or around the current period.

name: Present Perfect
description: Past actions connected with the present or unfinished time periods.
examples: She has lived here for two years.

name: Present Perfect Continuous
description: An activity that started in the past and continues or has a visible recent result.
examples: I have been working for two hours.

name: Past Continuous
description: An action that was in progress at a particular past time.
examples: I was working when she called.

name: Past Perfect
description: An action completed before another past action.
examples: I had left before he arrived.

name: Past Perfect Continuous
description: An activity that continued up to a point in the past.
examples: She had been working for hours before lunch.

name: Future Continuous
description: An action that will be in progress at a future time.
examples: I will be working at eight.

name: Future Perfect
description: An action that will be completed before a future point.
examples: I will have finished by Friday.

name: Future Perfect Continuous
description: An activity continuing up to a future point.
examples: By June, I will have been working here for a year.
